# Windtunnel

> Windtunnel measures how AI describes and recommends brands, then tests Current and New messages under shared conditions. Audit evidence is measured; AI recommendation and Buyer response comparisons are simulated. Results disclose routes, modes, dates, sample sizes and limits, and trace to stored answers.

## Research

- [AI knows SK Jewellery. What would make it recommend the brand?](https://windtunnel.tech/research/sk-jewellery-ai-visibility-message-test): Measured / Simulated. Strong sampled visibility, an inconclusive recommendation test, and six buyer profiles that turn the next content brief into a testable question.
- [The candidate message scored no better than the current one.](https://windtunnel.tech/research/hotel-group): Simulated. An anonymized hotel Buyer response test: 3.45 versus 3.41, n=30 per message. Independent study; not a client.
- [Two partnership messages, two tests, two different answers.](https://windtunnel.tech/research/insta360-message-lift): Simulated / Directional. Separate Buyer response tests, different baselines, n=5 per engine per message. Insta360 was not a client.
- [The newest story appeared in 0 of 25 answers.](https://windtunnel.tech/research/insta360): Measured / Directional. Five bare prompts, five repetitions, human-reviewed descriptions. Independent study; Insta360 was not a client.
- [Research hub](https://windtunnel.tech/research): studies and editorial method.

## Method

- [Repeated sampling and confidence intervals](https://windtunnel.tech/methodology): how each prompt is sampled repeatedly, which metrics carry Wilson intervals, the n>=30 gate, and where a conclusion stops.
- [Repeated sampling](https://windtunnel.tech/method/repeated-sampling): every audit prompt runs k=5 times per model and mode; rates describe the distribution of answers.
- [Mention rate](https://windtunnel.tech/method/mention-rate): share of unbranded answers that name the brand unprompted; Wilson confidence interval.
- [Shortlist rate](https://windtunnel.tech/method/shortlist-rate): share of valid AI-recommendation answers that place the brand among the five ranked recommendations; also called top-five inclusion rate.
- [Top-choice rate](https://windtunnel.tech/method/top-choice-rate): share of valid AI-recommendation answers that rank the brand first.
- [Shortlist lift](https://windtunnel.tech/method/shortlist-lift): New minus Current shortlist rate, in percentage points, with a scenario-cluster bootstrap interval.
- [Stability index](https://windtunnel.tech/method/stability-index): mean pairwise Jaccard of top-5 tracked-brand sets across repeated samples; point estimate, no interval.
